Bathroom Renovation Quotation Malaysia: 2026 Costs & Sample

Published 19 November 2026

A bathroom renovation in Malaysia costs roughly RM3,000–8,000 for a cosmetic refresh, RM8,000–18,000 for a standard full renovation and RM15,000–35,000 for a mid to high-spec bathroom in 2026. A good quotation breaks that down into hacking, waterproofing, tiling, plumbing and sanitary ware, with the brands, sizes and quantities spelled out. Below are the published rates, what to include, and a sample quotation.

Bathroom renovation cost by scope (2026)

Scope Typical cost per bathroom What it usually covers
Cosmetic refresh RM3,000–8,000 Re-grouting, new fittings, no hacking
Standard full renovation RM8,000–18,000 Hack, new waterproofing, retile, new sanitary ware
Mid to high-spec RM15,000–35,000 Feature or porcelain tiles, glass screen, rain shower
Premium RM30,000–50,000+ Large-format slabs, freestanding tub, new layout

These ranges come from several 2026 guides, which group the tiers slightly differently. A full bathroom renovation usually takes 10–15 working days.

Rates by item

Item Typical 2026 rate Unit
Hacking and disposal RM2,000–3,000 per bathroom
Waterproofing membrane, floor and walls RM1,500–4,000 per bathroom
Ceramic tiles, supply & lay RM8–15 per sq ft
Porcelain tiles, supply & lay RM14–28 per sq ft
Large-format tiles (600 × 1200mm and up), supply & lay RM22–45 per sq ft
Moving floor waste, shower or basin points RM1,500–6,000 per bathroom
Sanitary ware set, basic RM1,500–3,000 per bathroom
Sanitary ware set, mid-range RM3,000–7,000 per bathroom
Built-in acrylic bathtub RM1,200–3,500 + RM800–2,000 to build and tile each

The biggest swings come from moving plumbing points and the tile size. Keeping the existing layout is the cheapest way to do a full renovation.

What to include in a bathroom quotation

  • Protection and permits: floor and lift protection, and management approval in condos.
  • Hacking: what’s removed (floor tiles, wall tiles, existing fittings, bathtub) and debris disposal.
  • Screeding to falls: so water drains to the floor trap.
  • Waterproofing: the product, the coverage (floor, and walls up to what height) and the curing time before tiling. Quote a fresh membrane, not tiling over the old one.
  • Tiles: size, type, and the area for floor and walls separately, with a wastage allowance.
  • Plumbing: which points are kept and which are moved.
  • Sanitary ware and accessories: brand and model, or “supplied by client, installation only”.
  • Shower screen, ceiling, lighting and exhaust fan.
  • Exclusions: for example, water heater, mirror cabinet, or accessories not listed.

Sample bathroom renovation quotation

A 5 × 8 ft bathroom (40 sq ft), full renovation on the existing layout except for moving the shower and basin waste points, with client-supplied sanitary ware. The rates are illustrative, picked from within the ranges above.

Item Unit Qty Rate (RM) Amount (RM)
Floor & lift protection lot 1 300.00 300.00
Hack existing floor & wall tiles, incl. disposal lot 1 2,500.00 2,500.00
Screed floor to falls sq ft 40 12.00 480.00
Waterproofing membrane, floor and walls to 1.8m lot 1 2,200.00 2,200.00
Supply & lay porcelain floor tiles sq ft 40 18.00 720.00
Supply & lay porcelain wall tiles sq ft 220 18.00 3,960.00
Relocate shower and basin waste points lot 1 1,800.00 1,800.00
Install WC, basin and shower set (client supplied) lot 1 600.00 600.00
Tempered glass shower screen lot 1 1,500.00 1,500.00
Moisture-resistant ceiling board sq ft 40 9.00 360.00
Exhaust fan point point 1 180.00 180.00
Total 14,600.00

That’s within the RM8,000–18,000 band for a standard full renovation. If the client wants you to supply a mid-range sanitary ware set, add it as a separate line with the brand, so they can see what they’re paying for.

Common bathroom quotation mistakes

  • “Waterproofing” with no detail. Say what product, which surfaces and how high up the walls.
  • No curing time in the schedule, which tempts the team to tile too early.
  • Unclear sanitary ware: who supplies it, and which models.
  • One rate for floor and wall tiles when the areas and tile types differ.
  • Forgetting screeding, disposal or the exhaust fan, small lines that add up.

If the client changes the tiles or layout halfway, use a variation order before you order materials. For the rest of the house, see the renovation cost per sq ft guide and the kitchen cabinet quotation guide. Our free renovation quotation template has a section for each of these trades.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Malaysia in 2026?
Published 2026 guides put a cosmetic refresh without hacking at roughly RM3,000 to RM8,000 per bathroom, a standard full renovation at roughly RM8,000 to RM18,000, and mid to high-spec bathrooms at RM15,000 to RM35,000. Premium bathrooms with large-format slabs or a freestanding tub can exceed RM30,000.
How much does bathroom waterproofing cost in Malaysia?
Roughly RM1,500 to RM4,000 per bathroom for a full membrane to the floor and walls, according to 2026 guides. Allow 3 to 5 days for the membrane to cure before tiling.
How long does a bathroom renovation take?
About 10 to 15 working days for a full bathroom renovation, including the curing time for waterproofing. Doing two bathrooms one after the other keeps one usable during the works.
Should sanitary ware be included in the quotation?
State it either way. Either price the WC, basin, shower set and accessories with the brand and model, or write that they are supplied by the client and quote installation only. Leaving it unclear is one of the most common reasons for disputes.
